about.title: WELCOME TO SAUDI ARENA
about.subtitle: A digital destination celebrating the energy, talent, and ambition of Saudi esports.
about.story_text: Saudi Arena is a digital platform designed to showcase the exciting world of Saudi esports. We bring tournaments, teams, players, games, and achievements together in one place, making competitive gaming easier to discover and explore.

values.title: OUR MISSION
values.description: To create an engaging destination where esports fans can explore Saudi gaming competitions, discover teams, and celebrate competitive talent.

values.title: OUR VISION
values.description: To inspire greater interest in esports and highlight the growing opportunities within Saudi Arabia's competitive gaming community.

values.title: OUR PASSION
values.description: We believe gaming connects people through competition, teamwork, creativity, and unforgettable moments.

featured_teams.name: Twisted Minds
featured_teams.description: Twisted Minds is a Saudi esports organization competing across multiple games and international tournaments, representing the Kingdom on the global stage.

featured_teams.name: R8 Esports

featured_players.name: madv
featured_players.description: Modhi Alkanhal is a professional Saudi Valorant player and in-game leader for Falcons Vega. She is one of the most recognized female esports competitors in Saudi Arabia.
achievements: Saudi Female Player of the Year: 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025
featured_players.highlight_description: A memorable championship moment from madv's competitive Valorant career.

featured_players.name: trk511
featured_players.description: Mohammed Alotaibi is a Saudi Rocket League professional known for his mechanical skill and international tournament performances. He previously competed with Team Falcons.
achievements: Champion - FIFAe World Cup 2024 with Saudi Arabia
Champion - RLCS Raleigh Major 2025 with Team Falcons
Saudi Esports Male Player of the Year 2022
featured_players.highlight_description: A championship celebration from trk511's Rocket League career.

featured_players.name: Rw9
featured_players.description: Saleh Bakhashwin is a Saudi Rocket League player known for his defensive abilities and competitive performances. He competes alongside his twin brother Kiileerrz.
achievements: Champion - FIFAe World Cup 2024 with Saudi Arabia
featured_players.highlight_description: Rw9 celebrates a major Rocket League championship.

featured_players.name: Kiileerrz
featured_players.description: Yazeed Bakhashwin is a Saudi Rocket League professional and world champion. He plays for Team Falcons alongside his twin brother Rw9.
achievements: Champion - FIFAe World Cup 2024 with Saudi Arabia
featured_players.highlight_description: Kiileerrz celebrates a championship victory with his team.

featured_players.name: Msdossary
featured_players.description: Mosaad Aldossary, known as Msdossary, is a Saudi FIFA eWorld Cup 2018 champion and the CEO, Co-Founder and Chairman of Team Falcons. He helped establish the Saudi esports organization as a major competitor on the international esports stage.
featured_players.highlight_description: Msdossary celebrates his FIFA world championship victory in London.

featured_players.name: Exnid
featured_players.description: Saud Al-tai, known as Exnid, is a Saudi professional Call of Duty player. He has competed in the Call of Duty League and represented Falcons teams in professional competition.
featured_players.highlight_description: Highlights from Exnid's professional Call of Duty career.

featured_achievements.title: Esports World Cup Club Champion 2024
featured_achievements.description: Team Falcons made history by winning the inaugural Esports World Cup Club Championship in Riyadh, marking a major milestone for Saudi esports.

featured_achievements.title: Esports World Cup Club Champion 2025
featured_achievements.description: Team Falcons defended their Esports World Cup Club Championship title, securing back-to-back victories on the global stage.

featured_achievements.title: FIFAe World Cup 2024 Champions
featured_achievements.description: Saudi Arabia celebrated an international Rocket League world title at the FIFAe World Cup 2024.

featured_achievements.title: RLCS Raleigh Major 2025 Champions
featured_achievements.description: Team Falcons captured the RLCS Raleigh Major 2025 trophy, adding another prestigious international Rocket League title to Saudi esports history.

featured_achievements.title: Overwatch World Cup 2023 Champions
featured_achievements.description: Saudi Arabia made history by winning the Overwatch World Cup 2023 after defeating China in a thrilling grand final, securing a historic world title for Saudi esports.

featured_achievements.title: FIFAe World Cup 2025 Runner-Up
featured_achievements.description: Saudi Arabia reached the FIFAe World Cup 2025 Rocket League grand final and finished as world runner-up, adding another major international achievement to the nation's esports history.
